record.name: Haywire
record.narrative: You channel lightning energy through your power, unleashing destructive force that crackle across their body with electrical fury. The power manifests as crackling electricity, burning ozone, creating a moment of destructive fury.
record.flavor_text: I've got a bad feeling about this.

manifestation.description: aiming and firing weapon with precision

base_effect.description: You send a small electrical pulse that can disrupt electronic devices and droids.

mechanics.notes: Deal 1d4 lightning damage to droids and electronic devices

class_synergies.narrative: Engineer naturally embodies Haywire's essence, channeling harnessing technology for mechanical superiority with instinctive grace. Their creation philosophy aligns perfectly with Haywire's purpose, allowing them to mechanical whirring with enhanced calculated precision.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Engineers gain +1 to Tech power attack rolls.

species_synergies.narrative: Human adaptability allows them to quickly master new powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans gain advantage on power learning checks.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Rebel Alliance values technological expertise.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Rebels gain +2 to Tech power saving throw DCs.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the lightning damage affecting the target. Focus on how the power's effects manifest physically and mechanically, emphasizing deal lightning damage.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Haywire is excellent for dealing lightning damage to targets within range. Use it at 30 feet range.
narrative_hooks: A combatant uses Haywire to devastating effect, the lightning damage overwhelming their foe
The raw power of Haywire is unleashed, lightning energy coursing through the battlefield

image_generation.base_prompt: A dramatic digital painting of. Haywire. in action. unleashing devastating lightning damage. with crackling electricity, burning ozone. The mood is destructive fury, showing the raw power and intensity of the effect.
